Milk / Dairy.explanation: Contains dairy proteins (casein or whey) or milk sugar that trigger milk allergies or lactose intolerance.

Peanuts.explanation: Contains peanut proteins or botanical synonyms (Arachis hypogaea) capable of triggering severe anaphylaxis.

Gluten / Wheat.explanation: Contains gluten storage proteins harmful to individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.
alternatives: Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1 GF Baking Flour

Soy.explanation: Contains soy proteins or soy-derived emulsifiers (lecithin) commonly hidden in packaged snacks and chocolates.

Tree Nuts.explanation: Contains tree nut proteins or botanical names that can cause severe allergic reactions.
alternatives: Enjoy Life Mountain Mambo Seed Mix

Eggs.explanation: Contains egg white or yolk proteins (such as ovalbumin or lysozyme) that trigger egg allergies.
alternatives: Bob's Red Mill Gluten-Free Egg Replacer

Shellfish.explanation: Contains crustacean or mollusk tropomyosin proteins that trigger shellfish allergies.
alternatives: Ocean's Halo Organic Vegan Fish Sauce
